title: Pre Combat Combat Overhaul
description: Adds new weapons and mechanics to combat.
body:
# Pre-Combat: Combat Overhaul V 1.0.0 - 1.2.0 ⚔️💥

Transform your Minecraft combat experience! This mod completely revamps the classic sword-only combat system, introducing a variety of weapons that each offer unique strategies and playstyles. Facing enemies is no longer just about clicking fast — knowing which weapon to use and when can make all the difference.                                                                                           






## 🔹 Key Features

## New Melee Weapons:

### 🗡️ Sickle: 

Fast and agile, perfect for multiple enemies at once.

### ⚒️ War Axe:

Heavy-hitting weapon that deals high damage to a single target and can knock enemies back.

### 🛡️ Claymore:

Long reach and powerful strikes make it ideal for dominating the battlefield, requiring strategic use.









Special effect arrows can slow enemies, set them on fire, or deal extra damage.

### 💥 Enhanced Combat Mechanics:

Battles are more dynamic and strategic.

Each weapon has a unique feel and attack style; no more “just click to win” combat.






## 🔹 Why Download This Mod?

Combat in Minecraft is no longer repetitive; strategy and weapon choice matter.

Each weapon provides distinct advantages, letting you experiment with different tactics and playstyles.

Fighting enemies becomes more exciting and rewarding.

Enhances both PvP and PvE experiences, making each encounter feel like a fresh adventure.





## 🛡️ New Emerald Gear

✨ Emerald Tools & Armor Added! ✨

### Emerald Gears 
Emerald Sword, Pickaxe, Shovel, Axe – upgraded stats and special effects

### Emerald Armor Set 
Full set bonus: extra protection + buffs

Upgrade your Iron gear using Emeralds to craft these elite items


## 🛡️ Training Dummy System Added

A brand new Training Dummy entity has been added to help players practice combat and test their weapons.

⚔️ Practice your attacks without worrying about breaking anything
🪵 Completely AI-free and does not fight back
💥 Shows particles and sound effects when hit
📊 Can be used for combat training and testing weapon damage

You can spawn the Training Dummy using special methods and use it to improve your skills before real battles!



## 🔧 Installing Guide

1. Download the mod for the compatible Minecraft version.  
2. Place the mod `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.  
3. Launch Minecraft with the appropriate loader.  
4. Enjoy your new weapons and enhanced combat!  



(We will continue to improve this mod as much as possible — stay tuned! New versions and loader ports may be coming soon.)
